name: hair-stats-field
prompt: The test Hair.MotionGoesFromNaturalToSolid compared wall-clock milliseconds, which fails now and then on a busy CI machine. It now compares solver iterations instead, read from RigidWorld::hairStats(hair).iterations once after setHairMotion: 0 for solid hair (motion 0, the body is out of the physics world and not solved), fewer at motion 0.4 than at motion 1.0. Add one field to struct kke::HairStats: `uint32_t iterations = 0;` with a short comment above it saying it is the solver iterations per step summed over the hair's pieces, 0 when the hair is solid. Change nothing else.
